title: Constructing a whPRP-Secure Block Cipher
summary: No block cipher was designed for whPRP security; SPACE-hard ciphers are conjectural candidates, leaving construction or existence of a whPRP-secure block cipher open.

formal_statement.body: Construct or establish the existence of a block cipher satisfying $\mathrm{whPRP}$ security. No existing block cipher was designed with $\mathrm{whPRP}$ as its security goal, although some $\mathrm{SPACE}$-hard block ciphers are expected to be candidates; this expectation is conjectural and supported by cryptanalytic evidence rather than a proof.

scope.domain: Design of block ciphers with whPRP security, including SPACE-hard candidate ciphers.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a block cipher satisfying whPRP security or establish that one exists.

citations.label: A Modular Approach to the Incompressibility of Block-Cipher-Based AEADs

progress.summary: The paper explicitly asks whether the required whPRP-secure block ciphers exist. It presents SPACE-hard block ciphers only as conjectural candidates supported by cryptanalytic evidence, not by a proof.
